digest.component_or_area: CLI author guides and commit-trailer documentation
propositions: CLI-served author guides contain consumer-relative hyperlink targets (e.g., review-policy.md, ../CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/commit-ticket-trailer.md) that dangle for clients without a rebar repo checkout
The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT from verify_commit.py) has no first-class CLI-discoverable home; it is only documented in rebar verify-commit-ticket --help output
Packaged guides must repoint all dangling references to either sibling guides via rebar explain <topic> or canonical hosted URLs (https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main/...)
A new packaged guide commit-ticket-trailer.md must be added to src/rebar/_guides/, registered in AUTHOR_GUIDES, and served by rebar explain commit-trailer
Link-resolution guard tests must enforce that no packaged guide contains consumer-relative paths, only https://, http://, #anchor, or mailto: targets
MCP tool explain_criterion docstring and AUTHOR_GUIDES registry must list all discoverable guides so the guide inventory cannot drift
